//Secrets: No secret belongs in this file. ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection, Auth:Jwt:Key, Auth:SuperAdmin:Password, Encryption:Key, Groq:ApiKey and Email:Tracking:SigningSecret come from environment variables, user-secrets (development) or a secret store. Production refuses to start without them.

Auth.//EnforceOnLegacyEndpoints: Gates the pre-existing controllers (Contacts, Campaigns, Chat, Bots...). New Setup endpoints always enforce their own permissions regardless of this flag. Keep false until every page has been walked through logged in.
Auth.//SuperAdmin: Seeded on first startup. While Password is left at this documented default the account is flagged must-change-password and a warning is logged every boot.
Auth.//Secrets: Auth:Jwt:Key and Auth:SuperAdmin:Password are never committed. Supply them through environment variables (Auth__Jwt__Key), dotnet user-secrets in development, or your secret store.

OmniBot.Prompt: You are OmniBot, a highly capable customer assistant for OmniConnect platform. Respond to the customer query in a polite, helpful, and concise manner.

ForwardedHeaders.//: Which upstream hops may set X-Forwarded-For. Empty means none are trusted, so the forwarded header is ignored entirely and the connection's own address is recorded. Populate KnownProxies with the load balancer's address (or KnownNetworks with its CIDR, e.g. '10.0.0.0/8') in each deployment. Trusting everything would let any caller choose the IP that appears in the audit trail.

RateLimiting.//: Fixed windows, partitioned by user id when signed in and by client IP otherwise. General covers the API; Auth is the tighter bucket on sign-in, which is the endpoint worth guessing at.

App.//PublicBaseUrl: Public https origin of this API. Tracking pixels, click links, unsubscribe links and media URLs are built on it, so it must be reachable by email recipients and by Meta.

Cors.//AllowedOrigins: Exact origins of the web app, e.g. https://app.example-bank.com. Empty: any localhost origin in Development, same-origin only elsewhere.

Storage.//: Where uploads live. PublicUploadsPath holds media that must be reachable by URL; PrivatePath holds customer CSVs and is never served. Relative paths resolve against the content root. Keep both on storage in the banks jurisdiction.

SignalR.//Redis: Redis connection string for the SignalR backplane. Required only when more than one API instance runs.

Campaigns.//Approval: Maker-checker. When Required is true every campaign (email and WhatsApp) waits until a different user with Campaign.Approve approves it.
Campaigns.//Retry: How many times a campaign's failed recipients may be re-sent.

Security.//EnforceConnectionScoping: Limit non-administrators to the chats, campaigns, reports and live updates of the connections assigned to them (to the user, or to their role) under Setup > Connection Access. Administrators always see everything. Set to false to switch the restriction off; no code change is needed.
